description: This file provides utility functions for handling CSV files and filesystem operations, including reading CSV data into entities with a mapping function and finding filenames in directories using bash commands.

methods.name: CSVFileToEntities
methods.description: Reads a CSV file, maps each row to an entity using a supplied mapper function, and returns a list of entities or an error.

methods.name: FindFnamesInDir
methods.description: Searches for specified filenames within a directory using a bash find and grep command, returning matching filenames.
